rapport_notes: Genuinely warm repeat-customer call - referenced specifics from the prior move (metal rack, the bike) unprompted, which built real rapport.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked directly - the call leaned on the returning customer's known profile instead.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "The shorter the move, the lower the cost" plus the self-disassembly tip were both delivered.

top_strength: Used the customer's move history proactively ("I already took note of the metal rack... do you have anything like a piano, workout equipment, or a safe?") to speed discovery and build trust.
coaching_note: Never asked the agenda question even once - with a repeat customer this is an easy opportunity to check if anything's changed emotionally about the move, not just logistically.
